title: Sources: following investor backlash, Monzo to give outgoing CEO TS Anil an expanded role after he steps down in February; he is likely to retain a board seat (Laith Al-Khalaf/Financial Times)
summary: Laith Al-Khalaf /Financial Times:Sources: following investor backlash, Monzo to give outgoing CEO TS Anil an expanded role after he steps down in February; he is likely to retain a board seat—  UK digital bank due to give current chief executive broader than expected remit when he steps down next month
